_comment: FROZEN consult-check UserPromptSubmit injector. hooks-ensure-infra.md MERGES this single entry into the consumer's .claude/settings.json hooks.UserPromptSubmit array — never overwrites the file or other hooks. Fires on every prompt; pure read of the .claude/.consult-catalog cache written by consult-check-sessionstart.sh (its .hook.json sibling — install as a pair). Command path is $CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR-relative so it resolves from any cwd inside the repo.
